stem: A technician notices visible pest-like stippling on a donor plant scheduled for cloning. What is the best next action?
choices: Take the required cuttings and note the concern later
Skip sanitation so the donor is handled quickly
Hold or flag the donor material and escalate before propagating it
Move the donor into the rooting area for closer observation
rationale: Questionable donor material should be held or escalated before it seeds a new propagation batch with possible pest or health problems.
